name: Dheonix
description: A dheonix is the demonic version of the phoenix, often portrayed as being an omen of the 'end times' -  a bird shaped harbinger of doom wreathed in dark flames. This massive demon is notoriously hard to kill, being able to reform within the fires it creates.

actions.name: Firebolt
actions.description: The dheonix hurls a projectile of flames towards a creature, dealing fire damage.

actions.name: Dheonix Fire
actions.description: The dheonix targets a flame within 20 units and converts it to a specialized fire, causing the flame to turn black and give off a purple light that pulses with dark energy. Any creature who touches the flame, such as to extinguish it, takes 2d12 dark damage.

actions.name: Dark Pulse
actions.description: The dheonix targets a flame under the effect of the Dheonix Fire action and causes it to pulse with energy in a 3 unit radius, dealing dark damage. Any flame within that area affected is also converted as if it were the target of the Dheonix Fire action. The dheonix can target itself for this ability.

actions.name: Reform
actions.description: After being destroyed, the dheonix reforms up to 4 units above one of it's flames created by the Dheonix Fire action with 60 health. The dheonix must wait at least one round after using the Font of Flames action before using this ability.

actions.name: Talon Rake
actions.description: The dheonix flies in a 3 unit wide line that is 3 to 6 units long, striking anyone within the area with their talons. Creatures who avoid this attack do not take splash damage.

actions.name: Noxious Smoke
actions.description: In response to a creature taking an action, the dheonix targets either itself or a flame created by the Dheonix Fire action and creates a smoke cloud around it in a 3 unit radius. The attacking creature must make a resilience check of 10 or higher, or suffer a 2d4 penalty to their attack roll.

actions.name: Font of Flames
actions.description: The dheonix explodes in a glorious plume of flames, destroying itself and striking everyone within 5 units with fire and dark damage.

traits.name: Dark Rebirth
traits.description: As long as there is one dheonix flame burning, the dheonix is not destroyed. Instead it uses the Reform action at the next opportunity.

traits.name: Greater Demon
traits.description: The dheonix is a demon and gains an additional 6 physical mitigation against weapons and ammunition that do not have the blackened property.
